content.text:
=== required modules ===
DBI OK
DBD::mysql OK
IO::Socket::SSL OK
Authen::SASL OK
MIME::Base64 OK
MIME::QuotedPrint OK
Net::SMTP OK
Net::LDAP OK
Digest::SHA OK
JSON::PP OK
IO::Uncompress::Unzip OK
=== daemon syntax ===
/opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl syntax OK

observation.command: echo "=== required modules ==="; for m in DBI DBD::mysql IO::Socket::SSL Authen::SASL MIME::Base64 MIME::QuotedPrint Net::SMTP Net::LDAP Digest::SHA JSON::PP IO::Uncompress::Unzip; do perl -M$m -e 1 2>/dev/null && echo "$m OK" || echo "$m MISSING"; done; echo "=== daemon syntax ==="; runuser -u qisutu -- env QISUTU_HOME=/opt/qisutu perl -c /opt/qisutu/bin/qisutu-daemon.pl 2>&1 | tail -3
